threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the tube' instead of 'the underground' and look at the bus maps like a lost tourist.
Caught a glimpse of a bloke fitting a saxophone under his jacket, then he hopped off at Tower Bridge. Bet that’s not his first gig on the night bus.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw three generations sharing a table at Kottbusser Tor, each with their own coffee ritual, I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain might you stumble upon a nightclub with a no cellphone policy, forcing you to actually engage with your surroundings—and the strangers next to you.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they know to pack a snack before a BART delay; that smoky Civic Center evacuation is just another Friday night inconvenience.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5 Fulton at Larkin this morning; the driver stopped to let a pigeon cross the road, and I swear it took its time. Just another day in the city.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just a pretty facade, but if they looked closer, they'd see the vibrant street art telling stories of local struggles.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by how they can't resist taking photos of every single building, even the ones the locals just pass by.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look lost when the bus doesn't stop at the right stop, and you're waiting in that awkward half-hurry on Mare Street.
Last night, the 21 bus driver sang along to his playlist. Made the whole ride feel like a secret concert, even with the usual late-night crowd.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids playing Fußball in the street, while their parents chatted over coffee at an outdoor café, I felt like I finally belonged.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find spontaneous street parties where random DJs set up with just a generator and a couple of lights, no permits needed.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they complain about BART delays affecting their taco run at 10 PM – like it’s a personal attack on their late-night cravings.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 today, and the driver blared 90s hip hop on the way up Mission. The whole bus was vibing, even the usual grumps were smiling.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gaudí is all there is to architecture here. They miss the hidden Modernista gems tucked in the side streets, like Casa Ramos.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newbie by their hesitation at the door of a bar, waiting for someone to show them a proper tapas order. Out of place, yet curious.
